name: VentraConnect Social Login
author: Fahad Aslam

sections.installation:
1. Upload the ventraconnect-social-login folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to ** VentraConnect Social Login**.
  4. Choose a provider (e.g., Google or Facebook) and add your OAuth credentials.
  5. Save changes – social login buttons will appear on the WordPress login and registration screens.
sections.faq:
Is VentraConnect Social Login secure?

Yes. VentraConnect uses official OAuth authentication flows provided by each social network. User credentials are never shared with or stored by your WordPress site. Authentication is handled directly by the provider, and only basic profile data is returned after successful login.

Does this plugin replace passwords completely?

Social login is optional. Users can continue to log in using their WordPress username and password unless you choose to enforce social-only login using custom rules or extensions.

Does it work with existing WordPress users?

Yes. If a user logs in with a social account that matches an existing email address, the social account is linked to that user automatically and no duplicate account is created.

Does it create new user accounts?

If the email address does not already exist, a new WordPress user account is created automatically using the social provider profile data.

What data is stored from social providers?

Only the provider user ID, name, email address, and avatar URL are stored. No access tokens or passwords are saved. Site owners can output a privacy notice using the ventraconnect_sl_privacy_notice_html filter.

Where do I get OAuth credentials?

Links to provider developer consoles are available in the plugin settings.

The plugin automatically generates the correct callback URL using WordPress admin-ajax.php. On a typical site it will look similar to:

https://example.com/wp-admin/admin-ajax.php?action=ventraconnect_sl_oauth_callback&provider=PROVIDER

You should always copy the callback URL shown in the plugin settings instead of hardcoding it.

Will this slow down my site?

No. Social login buttons are only loaded where they are displayed, and OAuth requests are made directly between your site and the provider only during login.

External Services

VentraConnect Social Login is an OAuth client only.

During login:

  1. The user is redirected to the selected provider such as Google or Facebook.
  2. The provider authenticates the user.
  3. The provider returns an authorization token to your site.
  4. VentraConnect retrieves basic profile data:
    • Provider user ID
    • Email address
    • Display name
    • Avatar URL

No user data is sent to or stored on servers owned by the plugin author.
All communication happens directly between your WordPress site and the provider official APIs.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Fix: Shortcode redirect_to parameter is now respected and no longer overridden by the global redirect setting.
  • Fix: Default login vs registration redirect URLs are applied correctly after social login.
  • Fix: Redirects are now more reliable when HOME/SITEURL or www/non-www hosts differ.
  • Tweak: Hardened OAuth callback/state handling to make popup and REST-based flows more robust.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
sections.description:
One-click login for WordPress with 15+ social networks – Google, Facebook, X, LinkedIn, Reddit, Discord, and more. VentraConnect Social Login lets users sign in or sign up to your WordPress site using popular social accounts, no passwords required.

Why use social login on WordPress?

  • Reduce login friction and abandoned registrations
  • Increase successful sign ups and return visits
  • Improve security by eliminating weak passwords
  • Match modern SaaS style authentication experiences

VentraConnect follows official OAuth standards and connects directly to each provider. There is no third party tracking and no external servers involved.

Core Features

15+ Social Login Providers

  • Google
  • Facebook
  • X
  • Microsoft
  • GitHub
  • LinkedIn
  • Discord
  • Slack
  • Twitch
  • Spotify
  • Reddit
  • TikTok
  • Amazon
  • Yahoo
  • WordPress.com
  • LINE

More providers are added regularly.

WordPress Login and Registration Integration

  • Works with default WordPress login and registration forms
  • Enable or disable providers individually
  • Show or hide buttons per form

Shortcode Support

  • Add social login buttons anywhere
  • Works with custom pages and page builders

Account Linking

  • Link multiple social accounts to a single WordPress user
  • Users can unlink providers from their profile

Profile Sync

  • Optionally sync name and avatar from the social provider

Button Styles

  • Light
  • Dark
  • Minimal (icon plus text)

Designed to work consistently across WordPress themes.

Role Friendly

  • Compatible with standard WordPress user roles
  • No role overrides or forced permissions

Diagnostics and Logging

  • Built in tools to help debug OAuth and login issues

Translation Ready

  • Fully translatable
  • Text domain: ventraconnect-social-login

Designed for Real World WordPress Sites

VentraConnect is built to scale beyond basic social login.

The free version focuses on clean and reliable social authentication. Advanced features such as WooCommerce login and checkout, passwordless login using Magic Link and OTP, LMS and membership integrations, advanced redirect rules, and analytics are planned for an optional Pro version.

You can start simple and grow without switching plugins later.

Each provider has its own Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. You are responsible for complying with those terms when enabling a provider.
